body:
First raised: 2026-10-05 (America/Los_Angeles), during the subject-by-subject review in #405.

## Finding and scope

Five French Polynesia group locations in #405 use Natural Earth 1:10m Admin1 fallback polygons. French Polynesia maritime, planning and government service pages support named Windward, Leeward, Austral, Marquesas and Tuamotu-Gambier groupings, but do not validate Natural Earth's boundary edges, legal tier, all-island assignment or completeness. The atlas also nests Windward and Leeward beneath Society Islands, so repeated grouping tiers and neighboring island membership need explicit treatment.

Subjects: `PYF-4963`, `PYF-4964`, `PYF-4965`, `PYF-4966`, `PYF-4967`.

The source and hierarchy crosswalk is in #405 and PR #1054. The retained scoped Natural Earth source extract SHA-256 is `dd3f4a5683c713fd89c00b41748d89771f905ef236feaacb7887818085f3d96e`; the original global Admin1 restoration pin and public-domain terms are recorded in that packet.

## Acceptance

- Inspect official French Polynesian territorial, municipal, maritime and planning sources to establish each group's actual purpose and current member islands; distinguish service/planning geography from statutory boundaries.
- Reconcile exact source components and neighboring/ nested granularity against lawful current island-scale boundary or land evidence, including small and uninhabited islands. Preserve uncertainty where an authoritative complete outline is unavailable.
- Retain lawful originals or restoration instructions, retrieval dates, hashes, terms, baseline pins and reproducible component/coverage findings with controls.
- Preserve current subject IDs, parents, history and release pins. Geography evidence/proposal only; no shared geography, production or imports.
- Deliver sourced bounded engineering/restoration handoffs for supported changes and obtain independent exact-head review.

This packet will not certify all French Polynesia geography or the South-Central Pacific region.

## Dependency and ownership

This issue depends on completion of #405. Begin only after #405 is merged/closed and its exact sources are available on main. Own only `data/regional-review/french-polynesia-group-boundaries-20261005/`.
